{{Quote|The attack on Ryvellia came as a shock to everyone here.''"<br />"''When I arrived in V'eldalv, there was nothing left except smoking ruins. I was lucky to find my nephew at all, let alone alive.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and [[Cryle Cavv]]|<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the inhabitants of [[V'eldalv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvellia]], staged an '''uprising''' against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial forces forcibly stopped the insurrection with an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that completely destroyed the city.<ref name="OoaK" /> After the uprising, [[Cryle Cavv]] returned to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] Ryvellia. In the ruins of V'eldalv, he rescued his nephew [[Sienn Sconn]] and discovered that his relatives, [[Tascin]] and [[Rannah]], had been killed during the bombardment.<ref name="SF" />
